entries.text: Nay, I am no spy. Though many think as such. There is a spy within# our humble abode. Yet, we are unable to ferret the spy out.

entries.text: 不，我不是间谍。虽然许多人也是这么想。在我们的住所里确实有一个间谍。然而我们无法找出那个间谍。

entries.source_text: Then how do you help the Followers?

entries.text: 你怎么帮助末世论者？
entries.source_text: 你怎么帮助末世论者？

entries.text: Tell me what you know about this spy. Maybe I can help.
entries.source_text: Tell me what you know about this spy. Maybe I can help.

entries.text: Tough luck, Mutie!
entries.source_text: Tough luck, Mutie!

entries.text: 晦气，变种人！
entries.source_text: 晦气，变种人！

entries.text: I think I found the spy. Now I will remove the problem.
entries.source_text: I think I found the spy. Now I will remove the problem.

entries.text: 我认为我找到了间谍。现在我将去解决这个问题。
entries.source_text: 我认为我找到了间谍。现在我将去解决这个问题。

entries.text: Once, I was as you are. But, through the interaction of the Nightkin# in Necropolis, I was thrust into this state.

entries.text: 曾经，我和你是一样的。但是，夜行团和大墓地使我变成了如今的情形。
entries.source_text: 曾经，我和你是一样的。但是，夜行团和大墓地使我变成了如今的情形。

entries.text: That's awful. But, tough luck. See you around.
entries.source_text: That's awful. But, tough luck. See you around.

entries.text: 真是可怕。运气糟透了。再见。
entries.source_text: 真是可怕。运气糟透了。再见。

entries.text: Why were you in Necropolis?
entries.source_text: Why were you in Necropolis?

entries.text: 为什么是您在大墓地？
entries.source_text: 为什么是您在大墓地？

entries.text: Where were you from originally?
entries.source_text: Where were you from originally?

entries.text: 你最初从哪来的？
entries.source_text: 你最初从哪来的？

entries.text: And now I will transform you once more. Rest in pieces.
entries.source_text: And now I will transform you once more. Rest in pieces.

entries.text: 现在我要再次修理你，让你死无全尸。
entries.source_text: 现在我要再次修理你，让你死无全尸。

entries.text: Some time ago, I lived in a place far to the north of here. They were having# a problem with the water supply and sought out people to find a way to fix it.

entries.text: 从前，我住在离这里很远的北方。他们出现了供水问题，于是找人找方法解决这个问题。

entries.text: Yes. The overseer of the community gave me a shotgun and some shells.# However, those were lost many years passed. Since I have never found anything,# I could not return.

entries.text: 是的。社区的所长给了我支散弹猎枪和一些子弹。然而，经过许多年那些东西都丢光了。因为我从未发现过任何东西，所以我没脸回去。

entries.text: That's really awful. I wish there was something I could do.

entries.text: Their leader is the head of a mutant army. What he does is take# pure humans and transform them. I'm not quite sure, because I was knocked# unconscious before the process.

entries.text: I will go kill them for you then.

entries.text: I thank you for your kindness. You do me a great service. Please,# accept this as a token of good will. I purloined it from the body of a# deceased renegade.

entries.text: 感谢你的好心。你帮了我一个大忙。为了表达我的谢意，请你务必收下这个。这个火焰喷射器是我从一个叛徒的尸体上拿来的。

entries.text: Be at peace then. I can understand your unease. Mayhaps another will# come to help remove this threat. Good day to you.

entries.text: 他们其余的人现在都死了。赛特做的很好。
entries.source_text: 他们其余的人现在都死了。赛特做的很好。

entries.text: That is good news indeed to hear. I am overjoyed to hear the destruction# of one evil and a town set free. Please, take this.
entries.source_text:
That is good news indeed to hear. I am overjoyed to hear the destruction
# of one evil and a town set free. Please, take this.

entries.text: 那的确是个好消息。我很高兴听到邪恶势力被摧毁，城镇被解放。请收下这个。
entries.source_text: 那的确是个好消息。我很高兴听到邪恶势力被摧毁，城镇被解放。请收下这个。

entries.text: Sarcasm and slights shall not deter me my benevolent disposition.# The time has come for you to depart. Good day.
entries.source_text:
Sarcasm and slights shall not deter me my benevolent disposition.
# The time has come for you to depart. Good day.

entries.text: 挖苦和轻蔑阻止不了我善良的性格。时间到了，请你离开，再见。
entries.source_text: 挖苦和轻蔑阻止不了我善良的性格。时间到了，请你离开，再见。

entries.text: My vault had no name. It was merely numbered 13.
entries.source_text: My vault had no name. It was merely numbered 13.

entries.text: 我的避难所没有名字。它就是第13号。
entries.source_text: 我的避难所没有名字。它就是第13号。

entries.text: That is where I am from.
entries.source_text: That is where I am from.

entries.text: 那是我来的地方。
entries.source_text: 那是我来的地方。

entries.text: Never heard of the place.
entries.source_text: Never heard of the place.

entries.text: 没听说过那地方。
entries.source_text: 没听说过那地方。

entries.text: Thanks for the info. Now I'm going to tell those Mutants about it.
entries.source_text: Thanks for the info. Now I'm going to tell those Mutants about it.

entries.text: 谢谢你的信息。现在我把它告诉那些变种人。
entries.source_text: 谢谢你的信息。现在我把它告诉那些变种人。

entries.text: Really? Has the Overseer finally seen his way through to allow people# to travel outside the Vault?
entries.source_text:
Really? Has the Overseer finally seen his way through to allow people
# to travel outside the Vault?

entries.text: 真的？所长最终允许人们离开避难所到外面去了吗？
entries.source_text: 真的？所长最终允许人们离开避难所到外面去了吗？

entries.text: No, he is still scared of the outside world.
entries.source_text: No, he is still scared of the outside world.

entries.text: 不，他仍然害怕外面的世界。
entries.source_text: 不，他仍然害怕外面的世界。

entries.text: No, he fears for the safety of the dwellers.
entries.source_text: No, he fears for the safety of the dwellers.

entries.text: 不，他为居民的安全担心。
entries.source_text: 不，他为居民的安全担心。

entries.text: Yes, he thinks everything is safe.
entries.source_text: Yes, he thinks everything is safe.

entries.text: 是，他认为一切都很安全。
entries.source_text: 是，他认为一切都很安全。

entries.text: I believed as such. He always was a cautious man. I pity him his# responsibility. May you fare better than myself on this fool's quest.
entries.source_text:
I believed as such. He always was a cautious man. I pity him his
# responsibility. May you fare better than myself on this fool's quest.

entries.text: 我同样相信。他总是很谨慎。我同情他所担负的责任。愿你的探索进展比我顺利。
entries.source_text: 我同样相信。他总是很谨慎。我同情他所担负的责任。愿你的探索进展比我顺利。

entries.text: I am glad to hear that he has come to his senses to allow the people out.# While it is far from safe out here, it will do good to restore the earth# once more. Farewell, my friend.
entries.source_text:
I am glad to hear that he has come to his senses to allow the people out.
# While it is far from safe out here, it will do good to restore the earth
# once more. Farewell, my friend.

entries.text: 我很高兴听到他允许人们外出到很远的地方。出来是很危险，但有助于恢复地球。再会，我的朋友。
entries.source_text: 我很高兴听到他允许人们外出到很远的地方。出来是很危险，但有助于恢复地球。再会，我的朋友。

entries.text: I doubt you would have, coming from the outside world. Now, I must retire.# Please be careful out there with those creatures who see to destroy.
entries.source_text:
I doubt you would have, coming from the outside world. Now, I must retire.
# Please be careful out there with those creatures who see to destroy.

entries.text: 我怀疑你是否来自外界。现在我要休息了。要是看见那些破坏者请小心。
entries.source_text: 我怀疑你是否来自外界。现在我要休息了。要是看见那些破坏者请小心。

entries.text: Nay, I doubt you would be able to do as such.
entries.source_text: Nay, I doubt you would be able to do as such.

entries.text: 反对，我怀疑你是否能够做到。
entries.source_text: 反对，我怀疑你是否能够做到。

entries.text: Try and stop me.
entries.source_text: Try and stop me.

entries.text: 试试来阻止我。
entries.source_text: 试试来阻止我。

entries.text: Why do you say that?
entries.source_text: Why do you say that?

entries.text: 你为什么那样说？
entries.source_text: 你为什么那样说？

entries.text: Because I will stop you.
entries.source_text: Because I will stop you.

entries.text: 因为我将阻止你。
entries.source_text: 因为我将阻止你。

entries.text: I know very little. The only things I know are that our scouts are the# only ones who ever go over to the Children to spy on them. No one else# is allowed because of the danger.
entries.source_text:
I know very little. The only things I know are that our scouts are the
# only ones who ever go over to the Children to spy on them. No one else
# is allowed because of the danger.

entries.text: 我所知不多，我只知道只有侦察兵被派出去侦查大教堂的教徒，其他人都不让去，因为这工作太危险了。
entries.source_text: 我所知不多，我只知道只有侦察兵被派出去侦查大教堂的教徒，其他人都不让去，因为这工作太危险了。

entries.text: Then it might be a scout. I will look into that.
entries.source_text: Then it might be a scout. I will look into that.

entries.text: 他或许是侦察员。我会去调查的。
entries.source_text: 他或许是侦察员。我会去调查的。

entries.text: I think that it is you. Now die!
entries.source_text: I think that it is you. Now die!

entries.text: 我认为那就是你。去死！
entries.source_text: 我认为那就是你。去死！

entries.text: I wish you would have been of greater intellect. No matter, I shall# dispense with you shortly.
entries.source_text:
I wish you would have been of greater intellect. No matter, I shall
# dispense with you shortly.

entries.text: 我真希望你能变得聪明点。不过无所谓了，我很快就不需要你了。
entries.source_text: 我真希望你能变得聪明点。不过无所谓了，我很快就不需要你了。

entries.text: All I know of the Children is that they are in league with these# Nightkin, super mutants.
entries.source_text:
All I know of the Children is that they are in league with these
# Nightkin, super mutants.

entries.text: 我只知道大教堂教徒与夜行团和超级变种人是同盟。
entries.source_text: 我只知道大教堂教徒与夜行团和超级变种人是同盟。

entries.text: It is they who transformed me from my original state of being in Necropolis.
entries.source_text: It is they who transformed me from my original state of being in Necropolis.

entries.text: 是他们在大墓地把我变成现在这个样子。
entries.source_text: 是他们在大墓地把我变成现在这个样子。

entries.text: That's awful. But, tough luck. See you around.
entries.source_text: That's awful. But, tough luck. See you around.

entries.text: 真可怕。晦气，再见。
entries.source_text: 真可怕。晦气，再见。

entries.text: Why were you in Necropolis?
entries.source_text: Why were you in Necropolis?

entries.text: 为什么你在大墓地？
entries.source_text: 为什么你在大墓地？

entries.text: Where were you from originally?
entries.source_text: Where were you from originally?

entries.text: 你最初从哪来的？
entries.source_text: 你最初从哪来的？

entries.text: And now I will transform you once more. Rest in pieces.
entries.source_text: And now I will transform you once more. Rest in pieces.

entries.text: 现在我要再次修理你，让你彻底安息。
entries.source_text: 现在我要再次修理你，让你彻底安息。

entries.text: Though I am different in appearance, I have much knowledge to impart# upon those who will listen.
entries.source_text:
Though I am different in appearance, I have much knowledge to impart
# upon those who will listen.

entries.text: 虽然我的外表不同，但我有很多知识传授给那些想听的人。
entries.source_text: 虽然我的外表不同，但我有很多知识传授给那些想听的人。

entries.text: I have no time for this, I'm leaving.
entries.source_text: I have no time for this, I'm leaving.

entries.text: 我没时间听这个，我要走了。
entries.source_text: 我没时间听这个，我要走了。

entries.text: What can you tell me?
entries.source_text: What can you tell me?

entries.text: 你能告诉我什么？
entries.source_text: 你能告诉我什么？

entries.text: Those whom the Followers and Children call Nightkin are not what they# seem. They have been created by one called the Lieutenant. I believe he may# follow another.
entries.source_text:
Those whom the Followers and Children call Nightkin are not what they
# seem. They have been created by one called the Lieutenant. I believe he may
# follow another.

entries.text: 那些夜行团似乎原本是一些末世论者的信徒和孩子。他们是由一个自称副官的家伙创造的。我相信他或许追随另一个幕后者。
entries.source_text: 那些夜行团似乎原本是一些末世论者的信徒和孩子。他们是由一个自称副官的家伙创造的。我相信他或许追随另一个幕后者。

entries.text: Some information. Well, I will be off.
entries.source_text: Some information. Well, I will be off.

entries.text: 不错的信息。我要走了。
entries.source_text: 不错的信息。我要走了。

entries.text: What can you tell me about this Lieutenant?
entries.source_text: What can you tell me about this Lieutenant?

entries.text: 关于这个副官你能告诉我什么？
entries.source_text: 关于这个副官你能告诉我什么？

entries.text: There isn't much that I know about him. Last I saw him, before my# untimely transformation, he was searching for pure humans.
entries.source_text:
There isn't much that I know about him. Last I saw him, before my
# untimely transformation, he was searching for pure humans.

entries.text: 关于他我知道的不多。我在转变之前最后看到的就是他。他正在搜寻纯种人类。
entries.source_text: 关于他我知道的不多。我在转变之前最后看到的就是他。他正在搜寻纯种人类。

entries.text: I will think on this for a while. Thank you.
entries.source_text: I will think on this for a while. Thank you.

entries.text: 我要好好考虑一下。谢谢你。
entries.source_text: 我要好好考虑一下。谢谢你。

entries.text: Can you hazard a hypothesis as to why this may be so?
entries.source_text: Can you hazard a hypothesis as to why this may be so?

entries.text: 你能否大胆假设一下他们为什么要这么做？
entries.source_text: 你能否大胆假设一下他们为什么要这么做？

entries.text: As yet, I am uncertain. Perhaps another group which seeks to disrupt# their ways would know.
entries.source_text:
As yet, I am uncertain. Perhaps another group which seeks to disrupt
# their ways would know.

entries.text: 目前为止，我还不敢确定。或许另外一个寻找瓦解他们方法的团体会知道。
entries.source_text: 目前为止，我还不敢确定。或许另外一个寻找瓦解他们方法的团体会知道。

entries.text: Thank you. Good day.
entries.source_text: Thank you. Good day.

entries.text: 谢谢你。再见。
entries.source_text: 谢谢你。再见。

entries.text: I regret that I cannot tolerate insolence. Be gone.
entries.source_text: I regret that I cannot tolerate insolence. Be gone.

entries.text: 我很遗憾我不能容忍傲慢。走开。
entries.source_text: 我很遗憾我不能容忍傲慢。走开。

entries.text: My entrance into the Followers was quite simple really. It was the# Followers who rescued me from the full effects of the transformation into# a heinous beast.
entries.source_text:
My entrance into the Followers was quite simple really. It was the
# Followers who rescued me from the full effects of the transformation into
# a heinous beast.

entries.text: 我进入末世论者之内真的相当简单，是那些信徒挽救了我。让我没变成一只可憎的畜牲。
entries.source_text: 我进入末世论者之内真的相当简单，是那些信徒挽救了我。让我没变成一只可憎的畜牲。

entries.text: I do not fully understand. Please, go on.
entries.source_text: I do not fully understand. Please, go on.

entries.text: 我不是很了解。请继续。
entries.source_text: 我不是很了解。请继续。

entries.text: Once, I was as you are now - a pure human. But, through the intervention# of Nightkin, I was taken to some place far removed from here.
entries.source_text:
Once, I was as you are now - a pure human. But, through the intervention
# of Nightkin, I was taken to some place far removed from here.

entries.text: 曾经，我和你是一样的纯种人类，但是在夜行团的干预，我被带到某个很远的地方。
entries.source_text: 曾经，我和你是一样的纯种人类，但是在夜行团的干预，我被带到某个很远的地方。

entries.text: Please, continue.
entries.source_text: Please, continue.

entries.text: 请继续。
entries.source_text: 请继续。

entries.text: I was not of a state in which to observe what transpired. All I# had known was that I awoke here and was tended by the good doctor.
entries.source_text:
I was not of a state in which to observe what transpired. All I
# had known was that I awoke here and was tended by the good doctor.

entries.text: 我不知道路上发生了什么，只知道我醒来就在这里了并由好医生照料着。
entries.source_text: 我不知道路上发生了什么，只知道我醒来就在这里了并由好医生照料着。

entries.text: I am truly sorry to hear of your predicament. I will find those# who did this to you and remedy the situation.
entries.source_text:
I am truly sorry to hear of your predicament. I will find those
# who did this to you and remedy the situation.

entries.text: 听说你的困境我感到很难过。我会找出那些对你下手的人给你个交代。
entries.source_text: 听说你的困境我感到很难过。我会找出那些对你下手的人给你个交代。

entries.text: I am sorry to hear of that. Alas, I am quite busy attempting to# survive. Farewell.
entries.source_text:
I am sorry to hear of that. Alas, I am quite busy attempting to
# survive. Farewell.

entries.text: 我很抱歉听说了那个。唉，我的生活相当忙碌。告辞。
entries.source_text: 我很抱歉听说了那个。唉，我的生活相当忙碌。告辞。

entries.text: Please, dispense justice upon the defouler who seeks to undermine# the trust of the Followers.
entries.source_text:
Please, dispense justice upon the defouler who seeks to undermine
# the trust of the Followers.

entries.text: 请找到那个正在破坏末世论者信徒之间信赖的间谍。
entries.source_text: 请找到那个正在破坏末世论者信徒之间信赖的间谍。

entries.text: Excellent job on removing from our midst that dissembler, Heather.
entries.source_text: Excellent job on removing from our midst that dissembler, Heather.

entries.text: 除去了我们中间那个叛徒希瑟，干得好。
entries.source_text: 除去了我们中间那个叛徒希瑟，干得好。

entries.text: You see a hideous ghoul.
entries.source_text: You see a hideous ghoul.

entries.text: 你看见一个丑陋的僵尸。
entries.source_text: 你看见一个丑陋的僵尸。

entries.text: Somehow, he reminds you of someone.
entries.source_text: Somehow, he reminds you of someone.

entries.text: 不知何故，他使你想起某人。
entries.source_text: 不知何故，他使你想起某人。

entries.text: Alas, I have no more time to spare on you. Good day.
entries.source_text: Alas, I have no more time to spare on you. Good day.

entries.text: 唉，我没有多余的时间浪费在你身上。再见。
entries.source_text: 唉，我没有多余的时间浪费在你身上。再见。
